_comment: Supported FAQ answers. The agent may say what is written here and nothing
else; anything not matched is handed to a representative rather than
'keywords' drive matching. 'answer' is spoken verbatim, so it is written
the way it should sound: short sentences, no markdown, no lists.

entries.answer: Our claims team is available Monday to Friday, eight in the morning until six in the evening, Eastern time. We're closed on weekends and public holidays.
Our mailing address is Observe Insurance, Claims Department, 400 Harbor Street, Suite 210, Boston, Massachusetts 02210. Please put your claim number on anything you send.

You can start a new claim on our website at observeinsurance.com, or by calling our claims line during office hours. You'll need your policy number and the date of the incident. It usually takes about ten minutes.

Once a claim is submitted, it's assigned to an adjuster who reviews it and may ask for supporting documents. After the review, we contact you with the decision. Most straightforward claims are reviewed within two weeks, though it depends on the claim.

You can upload documents at observeinsurance.com/documents, or email them to documents at observeinsurance.com. Please include your claim number on every page. Documents are usually reviewed within three business days.
